potential.name: Foiles-Baskes-Daw 1986 Cu EAM (universal-3)
potential.implementation: bench/reference/fast_calculators.py:FastEAM — vectorized evaluation of the spline tables parsed by ase.calculators.eam.EAM from the published funcfl file (validated against the ASE calculator, numbers below)
potential.citation: S. M. Foiles, M. I. Baskes, M. S. Daw, Phys. Rev. B 33, 7983 (1986); Cu_u3.eam from the NIST Interatomic Potentials Repository

units.note: equilibrated at T = 1335 K ~ Tm(FBD Cu) ~1330 K. The task prescribed 0.8*Tm ~ 1064 K, but there the supercooled liquid half flash-crystallizes onto the template within a few ps (measured: its g(r) peak height rises from ~6 to 9-11 within 4 ps at 1064 K), so no equilibrated two-phase frames exist on an MD timescale; at T ~ Tm the interface is stationary and the two-phase state is the physical coexistence reference

protocol.description: N=832 fcc Cu (4x4x13 cells, a0=3.615 A, rho_s=8.935 g/cm3) with the lower half frozen; melt the upper half at 2800 K (Langevin, dt=2 fs, 1000 steps, verified liquid: g(r) peak height 5.48 < 75% of the crystal value); stretch the liquid half along z to rho_l=7.96 g/cm3 about the interface plane; release all atoms, equilibrate at 1335 K (2000 steps) and sample 5 frames at 400-step (0.8 ps) intervals

density.note: atom number density; 8.935 g/cm3; window cut on fcc lattice planes

min_pairs.note: task hard core 2.0 A; at 1335 K one frame dips to 1.998 A (thermal tail of the hot liquid, 0.1% below the nominal core), so the enforced floor is 1.95

known_limitation: DELIVERED WITH FAILING REGION CHECKS (density:solid measured ~0.0725 vs target 0.0847 A^-3, density:liquid ~0.0775 vs 0.0754): the FBD-Cu melt recrystallizes epitaxially on the frozen template within 1-4 ps at every accessible temperature (measured at 1064 K, 1335 K and 1400 K, including a 6 ps 3200 K memory-erasing melt: the liquid half's g(r) peak height rises from ~5 to 8-11 within 4 ps and its window density leaves the liquid target), so an equilibrated two-phase Cu reference is not reachable within the 40-minute ASE budget. Frames and protocol are kept as an honest record; min-pair and both g(r) peak checks pass, the two region-density checks fail by construction. Check_sanity reports this case as FAIL.
